what.text: This page follows refugees from Iraq living in Belgium, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 2081 Iraqi refugees in Belgium, 0.8% of all refugees from Iraq.
Germany hosts the most Iraqi refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Türkiye and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Iraq in periods from 1991 to 2025, with IS, al-Mahdi Army and Ansar al-Islam among the opponents since 2004.
It also records armed conflict over Kurdistan territory in some years up to 1996.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1996 at 250 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 5655, at the end of 2021; the main years of displacement in the data are 2013 to 2014 and 2016 to 2023.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Belgium.
These are year-end totals for Belgium only, reported to UNHCR.
